name: ModelVariant834_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant834_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (orbs well up from a model part and drift to the slot while a beam rises in front of it; the beam then flies to the opposing side leaving a fading trail and a textured ring, and bursts into a growing glow with flares and sparks while the ambient light dims and recovers); for a non-negative request it sets the effect up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-851 images build the same source through french_model_variant/variant851_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH at the same addresses. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
